data.title: Recognition of son's school-way accident as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall)
data.summary: Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte recognises the cycling accident of Johanna Beispielacker's son Paul on his way to school on 14 September 2026 as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall) and will cover his medical and physiotherapy costs. The letter also informs about the right to object (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: This is good news: the statutory accident insurance confirms it will pay for Paul's medical treatment and physiotherapy, so you don't need to submit any receipts yourself—his doctors and physiotherapist will bill the Unfallkasse directly. If you disagree with any part of this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person with the Unfallkasse; the app shows until when you can do this. If you take no action, the decision simply becomes final. No payment is required from you at this time.

items.action: Let the doctors' and physiotherapy practices bill the Unfallkasse directly; do not forward the invoices yourself
items.quote: Rechnungen schicken die Praxen direkt an uns; bitte reichen Sie selbst keine Belege ein.
